Gred = Gfull

G entry placement?

All RAM constants
write g_mat_over in RAM_PASS1
call setupGMatrix

Some CODE-side G entries
create varG handles in GVALUES
assign varG directly when possible
avoid unnecessary set_CODE/get_CODE matrices

Write Ihis directly to Inj
no Schur flow and no Vk recovery

Source-level split by element support nodes
Retained-only elements: direct-retained path, not part of Schur elimination
constant direct terms: stamp in RAM_PASS1
runtime direct terms: update and add in CODE
elements touching internal nodes: core network for elimination and voltage recovery
Any Dummy / N-Dummy alignment nodes?

Dummy / N-Dummy nodes align cases with different visible structures
before C export, finalize them for the selected case
they are pruned or forced into elimination
they are not real retained-side stamp nodes

No Dummy / N-Dummy nodes
continue with physical node order

Core block partition
split the core network by node role
r: retained external nodes
k: internal nodes to eliminate
Grr: retained-retained block
Grk / Gkr: retained-internal coupling
Gkk: internal-internal block
Ihisr / Ihisk: retained/internal history vectors

Direct-retained placement
Gdirect / Ihisdirect never enter Gkk / W / Schur
RAM constants go to g_mat_over
CODE or STEP terms update varG / Inj
final equation adds them after Schur
Gkk structure?

Diagonal Gkk
only diagonal terms exist
W(k,k) = 1 / Gkk(k,k)
W(k,m) = 0 for off-diagonal entries

Scalar diagonal path
Gschur(i,j) = Grr(i,j) - Σk Grk(i,k)Gkr(k,j)/Gkk(k,k)
Ihis_schur(i) = Ihisr(i) - Σk Grk(i,k)Ihisk(k)/Gkk(k,k)
Vk(k) = -(Gkr(k,*)·Vr + Ihisk(k))/Gkk(k,k)
no explicit W matrix or matrix multiplication is required

Diagonal plus small coupled block
most internal nodes are diagonal-only
a small coupled subset has size ≤ 3
eliminate diagonal-only nodes first
then solve the small coupled block

Block inverse for the coupled subset
Gkk = [[D, U], [Uᵀ, S]]
D is diagonal, S is the small coupled block
M = S - UᵀD⁻¹U
use fast 2x2 / 3x3 symmetric inverse on M
W = [[D⁻¹ + D⁻¹UM⁻¹UᵀD⁻¹, -D⁻¹UM⁻¹], [-M⁻¹UᵀD⁻¹, M⁻¹]]

General Gkk
use runtime matrix inverse
avoid expanding a large symbolic inverse in Python

Shared intermediate DAG
W is already produced by the selected inverse path
compute shared intermediates
A = Grk · W
b = W · Ihisk
A serves both Gred and Vk
b serves both Ihisred and Vk

Symmetric-network reuse
if Gcore is symmetric, then Gkr = Grkᵀ and W is symmetric
W · Gkr = Aᵀ
Gschur_upper = Grr_upper - upper(A · Gkr)
Ihisschur = Ihisr - Grk · b
Vk = -Aᵀ · Vr - b

Vk recovery
Vk = -W · Gkr · Vr - W · Ihisk
core matrices only

Final assembly
Gfinal_upper = Gschur_upper + Gdirect_upper
Ihisfinal = Ihisschur + Ihisdirect
only upper-triangle G stamp entries are needed
each entry carries its RAM / CODE / STEP placement

C draft emission
write only required G / Ihis / Vk paths
omit zero entries
RAM constants do not enter CODE
unused MATRIX objects are not registered or conditioned
